title: ReplacePathRegex
description: ReplacePathRegex holds the replace path regex middleware configuration. This middleware replaces the path of a URL using regex matching and replacement. More info: https://doc.traefik.io/traefik/v3.7/middlewares/http/replacepathregex/

regex.description: Regex defines the regular expression used to match and capture the path from the request URL.

replacement.description: Replacement defines the replacement path format, which can include captured variables.
